description: Override a configuration value that would otherwise be loaded from `~/.codex/config.toml`. Use a dotted path (`foo.bar.baz`) to override nested values. The `value` portion is parsed as TOML. If it fails to parse as TOML, the raw string is used as a literal. Examples: - `-c model="o3"` - `-c 'sandbox_permissions=["disk-full-read-access"]'` - `-c shell_environment_policy.inherit=all`
reason: The structured native defaults editor persists these keys. This flag is an invocation override and takes precedence over saved defaults.

description: Enable a feature (repeatable). Equivalent to `-c features.<name>=true`
reason: Use the features editor for persistent defaults. This flag enables a feature only for the invocation.

description: Disable a feature (repeatable). Equivalent to `-c features.<name>=false`
reason: Use the features editor for persistent defaults. This flag disables a feature only for the invocation.
